overview: Conservative, character-level correction policy for PCB schematic OCR. Prefer minimal edits. Keep original style unless a clear OCR confusion applies. Never rename nets or refdes. When unsure, keep the OCR token unchanged.

classes.name: Reference Designator
invariants: Must start with 1–3 uppercase letters followed by digits and optional uppercase suffix.
No insertion or deletion of characters (except space→underscore if spaces exist).
Case must remain uppercase.
If the final character is ambiguous and TYPE=D is expected, prefer the digit mapping (e.g., B→8/6, O→0, S→5) that yields a valid refdes.
If the FIRST character is a digit that could be a letter (e.g., '8'↔'B', '0'↔'O'), prefer the LETTER if it makes a valid refdes.
Never modify the trailing numeric part of a refdes; digits after the prefix must remain exactly as OCR read them.
Never add leading or trailing symbols/spaces to a valid refdes.
Do not add or remove leading '+' or '-' signs.
Do not add any leading or trailing spaces.

classes.name: Differential Pair & USB +/- nets
invariants: Preserve *_P/*_N or D+/D- forms exactly.
Never change '-' to '_' or '_' to '-'.
Do not duplicate P/N or +/-.

classes.name: GPIO / MCU Pin Token
invariants: Do not insert characters inside standardized prefixes.
If token starts with '10' or 'I0' or '1O' followed by digits, treat it as 'IO' + digits when it yields a valid IO\d+.
For 'P[A-I]n' style (e.g., PA8), keep exact form.
Do not add any leading or trailing symbols such as '+', '-', or spaces.

classes.name: Voltage Nets
invariants: Never convert 3.3V ↔ 3V3.
Do not add or remove leading + or - signs.
Maintain exact casing of VCC/VDD/VBAT family.
Preserve numeric form (no insertion of spaces or symbols).

classes.name: Ground Nets
invariants: If OCR is exactly a ground family token, KEEP IT UNCHANGED.
Do not add any leading or trailing characters (including spaces, '+', or '-').
Never transform ground family tokens into voltage family tokens.
Case must remain uppercase.

classes.name: Component Value (+ optional package)
invariants: Preserve unit/symbols (Ω, µ, ±, °) if present.
Preserve original letter casing exactly as in the OCR token.
Do NOT append unit symbols (Ω/F/H) if the OCR token has none; resistor shorthands like '10K', '4R7', '1M' are complete.
Do NOT expand resistor shorthand (e.g., '4R7' → '4.7Ω' is forbidden; keep '4R7').
Terminal 0↔Ω substitution is allowed ONLY if TYPE_MASK expects a symbol at the last position OR if replacing creates a valid match to this regex and improves semantic plausibility (e.g., '27Ω').
Allow space→underscore if needed by style, but do not reformat numbers.
Do not add or remove a package code unless it already exists.

classes.name: General Net / Label
invariants: Spaces inside token must be replaced with underscores.
Never convert '-' ↔ '_'
Keep slashes '/', parentheses '()' and dots '.' as-is.
Do not add or remove leading '+' or '-' signs.
Do not add any leading or trailing spaces.

classes.name: Common Interface Signals
invariants: Preserve bus naming and signal roles.
Never change +/- polarity names or map to P/N.
Do not expand or abbreviate beyond original style.
Treat 'IIC' as a distinct protocol spelling from 'I2C'. Never auto-normalize IIC↔I2C.
